user.title: New OORT zone
user.description: A zone is one HVAC system and the rooms it serves. Next you'll add its rooms and, optionally, people.

data_description.name: Used in entity IDs, e.g. "Home" gives sensor.oort_home_temperature.

menu.title: Zone setup

defaults.title: Settings
defaults.description: **Room defaults** are used by every room in this zone unless the room overrides them. A **tau** is a time in minutes: roughly how long a room's weight takes to get two-thirds of the way to its new value. A **delay** is how many minutes someone must stay in a room (enter delay) or stay away (exit delay) before the room acts on it. **Weights** say how much each room counts.

data_description.tau_person_rise: Minutes for a room's weight to move about two-thirds of the way up to the person weight once a tracked person is in it. Smaller reacts faster; larger is smoother. Default {tau_person_rise_default}.
data_description.tau_person_fall: Minutes for the weight to fall back after the last tracked person leaves. Larger keeps the room counted during short trips out. Default {tau_person_fall_default}.
data_description.tau_occupancy_rise: Minutes to move up to the occupied weight once an occupancy sensor or template says someone is there (and no tracked person is); also for an empty room climbing back to the unoccupied weight. Default {tau_occupancy_rise_default}.
data_description.tau_occupancy_fall: Minutes to fall back after occupancy ends. Default {tau_occupancy_fall_default}.
data_description.tau_open: Minutes for a room to fade out when it becomes "open" (an opening entity turns on or the opening template turns true). 0 = instantly. Default {tau_open_default}.
data_description.tau_dropout: Minutes for a room to fade out when its temperature sensor becomes unavailable. 0 = instantly. Default {tau_dropout_default}.
data_description.delay_person_enter: Minutes a tracked person must stay in a room before it counts them. Ignores people passing through, or a location that briefly flips to this room. 0 = at once. Default {delay_person_enter_default}.
data_description.delay_person_exit: Minutes a room keeps counting a tracked person after they leave. Ignores a location that briefly flips away. 0 = at once. Default {delay_person_exit_default}.
data_description.delay_occupancy_enter: Minutes an occupancy sensor or template must stay on before the room counts as occupied. 0 = at once. Default {delay_occupancy_enter_default}.
data_description.delay_occupancy_exit: Minutes the room keeps counting as occupied after its occupancy sensors and template go off. 0 = at once. Default {delay_occupancy_exit_default}.
data_description.w_person: How much a room with a tracked person in it counts. Only the ratios between the weights matter. Default {w_person_default}.
data_description.w_occupied: How much an occupied room counts (sensor or template says someone is there, no tracked person). Default {w_occupied_default}.
data_description.w_base: How much an empty room counts. Keep it tiny so empty rooms barely move the temperature. Must be at least {w_base_minimum}. Default {w_base_default}.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Settings for the whole zone; rooms can't override these.

data_description.stale_limit: Minutes a room's last reading is still used after its temperature sensor drops out; after that the room is left out. Default {stale_limit_default}.

room.title: Add room
room.description: Each room is a Home Assistant area with its own temperature sensor.

data_description.area_id: The Home Assistant area this room is. It can't be changed later.
data_description.temperature_sensor: The sensor measuring this room's temperature.
data_description.occupancy_sensors: The room counts as occupied while any of these is on.
data_description.occupancy_template: When it renders true (true, on, yes, enable, or any number other than 0), the room also counts as occupied. Anything else, including unavailable, unknown or an error, counts as false.
data_description.opening_sensors: The room is left out while any of these is on, like a window or door being open (its weight fades to 0). Unavailable counts as closed.
data_description.opening_template: When it renders true (true, on, yes, enable, or any number other than 0), the room is also left out. Anything else, including unavailable, unknown or an error, counts as false.
